40021168.author: पदार्थः
40021168.content: ततो then, रामः Rama, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, विस्मयात् out of wonder, पुनरेव again indeed, हि indeed, उवाच spoke, प्रणतः bowing down, वाक्यम् words, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, ऋषिसत्तमम् the best among sages

40021168.author: Translation
40021168.content: Then, the greatly effulgent Rama, filled with wonder, again spoke words to Agastya, the best among sages, bowing down to him.

40021169.author: पदार्थः
40021169.content: भगवन् O revered one, राक्षसः the demon, क्रूरः cruel, यदाप्रभृति from when, मेदिनीम् the earth, पर्यटत् roamed, किम् whether, तदा then, लोकाः the worlds (people), शून्याः empty, आसन् were, द्विजोत्तम O best among twice-born (Brahmins)

40021169.author: Translation
40021169.content: O revered one, O best among Brahmins, when that cruel demon roamed the earth, were the worlds then empty of people?

40021170.author: पदार्थः
40021170.content: राजा a king, वा or, राजमात्रः a king's minister/equal to a king, वा or, किम् whether, तदा then, न not, अत्र here, कश्चन anyone, धर्षणम् humiliation/defeat, यत्र where, न not, प्राप्तः obtained/met, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of demons

40021170.author: Translation
40021170.content: Or was there no king or king's equal then, where Ravana, the lord of demons, did not meet with defeat or humiliation?

40021171.author: पदार्थः
40021171.content: उताहो or perhaps, हतवीर्याः whose valor was destroyed, ते those, बभूवुः became, पृथिवीक्षितः kings (earth-rulers), बहिष्कृताः expelled/deprived, वरास्त्रैः by excellent weapons, च and, बहवः many, निर्जिताः conquered, नृपाः kings

40021171.author: Translation
40021171.content: Or perhaps those kings became devoid of valor, and many rulers were conquered and deprived of their excellent weapons.

40021172.author: पदार्थः
40021172.content: राघवस्य of Rama (descendant of Raghu), वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हि indeed, अगस्त्यः Agastya, भगवान् the revered, ऋषिः sage, उवाच spoke, रामम् to Rama, प्रहसन् laughing, पितामहः grandfather (Brahma), इव like, ईश्वरम् to the lord (Shiva/Vishnu)

40021172.author: Translation
40021172.content: Having heard the words of Rama, the revered sage Agastya, laughing, spoke to Rama as Brahma would speak to the Lord.

40021173.author: पदार्थः
40021173.content: इत्येवं thus, बाधमानस्तु indeed oppressing, पार्थिवान् kings, पार्थिवर्षभ O best of kings, चचार roamed, रावणो Ravana, राम O Rama, पृथिवीं the earth, पृथिवीपते O lord of the earth.

40021173.author: Translation
40021173.content: O Rama, O best of kings, O lord of the earth, Ravana thus indeed roamed the earth, oppressing kings.

40021174.author: पदार्थः
40021174.content: ततो then, माहिष्मतीं Mahishmati, नाम named, पुरीं city, स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम् shining like a city of heaven, सम्प्राप्तो reached, यत्र where, सान्निध्यं presence, सदासीत् always was, वसुरेतसः of Vasuretasa.

40021174.author: Translation
40021174.content: Then he reached the city named Mahishmati, which shone like a celestial city, and where the presence of Vasuretasa (Agni) always resided.

40021175.author: पदार्थः
40021175.content: तुल्य equal, आसीत् was, नृपस्तस्य its king, प्रभावात् by the might, वसुरेतसः of Vasuretasa, अर्जुनो Arjuna, नाम named, यत्राग्निः where Agni, शरकुण्डेशयः residing in a pond of arrows, सदा always.

40021175.author: Translation
40021175.content: Its king, named Arjuna, was equal in might to Vasuretasa (Agni), where Agni always resided, known as Sharakuṇḍeśaya.

40021176.author: पदार्थः
40021176.content: तमेव that very, दिवसं day, सो ऽथ he then, हैहयाधिपतिर्बली the powerful lord of the Haihayas, अर्जुनो Arjuna, नर्मदां to the Narmada, रन्तुं to sport, गतः went, स्त्रीभिः with women, सहेश्वरः with his wives.

40021176.author: Translation
40021176.content: On that very day, the powerful lord of the Haihayas, Arjuna, had gone to the Narmada river with his wives to sport.

40021177.author: पदार्थः
40021177.content: तमेव that very, दिवसं day, सो ऽथ he then, रावणस्तत्र Ravana there, आगतः arrived, रावणो Ravana, राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु the lord of Rakshasas indeed, तस्यामात्यानपृच्छत asked his ministers.

40021177.author: Translation
40021177.content: On that very day, Ravana arrived there, and the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, then inquired of his ministers.

40021178.author: पदार्थः
40021178.content: क्व where, अर्जुनो Arjuna, नृपतिः the king, शीघ्रं quickly, सम्यक् properly, आख्यातुम् to tell, अर्हथ you ought; रावणो Ravana, अहम् I, अनुप्राप्तो have arrived, युद्धेप्सुः desirous of battle, नृवरेण with the best of men, ह indeed; मम my, आगमनम् arrival, अपि also, अग्रे before him, युष्माभिः by you all, सन्निवेद्यताम् let it be announced.

40021178.author: Translation
40021178.content: Ravana asks Arjuna's attendants to quickly and properly inform him of Arjuna's whereabouts, declaring his own arrival as Ravana, desirous of battle with the best of men, and instructing them to announce his presence to the king.

40021179.author: पदार्थः
40021179.content: इति thus, एवं in this manner, रावणेन by Ravana, उक्ताः spoken to, ते those, अमात्याः ministers, सुविपश्चितः very wise, अब्रुवन् they said, राक्षसपतिम् to the lord of Rakshasas, असान्निध्यम् the absence, महीपतेः of the king.

40021179.author: Translation
40021179.content: Thus addressed by Ravana, those very wise ministers informed the lord of Rakshasas about the king's absence.

40021180.author: पदार्थः
40021180.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, विश्रवसः of Vishravas, पुत्रः the son, पौराणाम् from the citizens, अर्जुनं Arjuna, गतम् had gone, अपसृत्य having departed, आगतो he came, विन्ध्यं to the Vindhya, हिमवत् like the Himalayas, सन्निभं resembling, गिरिम् mountain.

40021180.author: Translation
40021180.content: Having heard from the citizens that Arjuna had departed, Ravana, the son of Vishravas, also departed and came to the Vindhya mountain, which resembled the Himalayas.

40021181.author: पदार्थः
40021181.content: सः he, तम् that, अभ्रम् a cloud, इव like, आविष्टम् pervaded, उद्भ्रान्तम् bewildered, इव like, मेदिनीम् the earth; अपश्यत् he saw, रावणो Ravana, विन्ध्यम् the Vindhya, आलिखन्तम् scratching, इव as if, अम्बरम् the sky.

40021181.author: Translation
40021181.content: Ravana saw that Vindhya mountain, which seemed to pervade the clouds and bewilder the earth, as if it were scratching the sky.

40021182.author: पदार्थः
40021182.content: सहस्र a thousand, शिखर peaks, उपेतं endowed with, सिंह by lions, अध्युषित inhabited, कन्दरम् caves; प्रपात from waterfalls, पतितैः fallen, तोयैः by waters, स with, अट्टहासम् loud laughter, इव like, अम्बुधिम् the ocean.

40021182.author: Translation
40021182.content: He saw the mountain endowed with a thousand peaks, its caves inhabited by lions, and its waters falling from waterfalls, resembling the ocean with its loud laughter.

40021183.author: पदार्थः
40021183.content: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः by gods, demons, and gandharvas, साप्सरोगणकिन्नरैः with groups of apsaras and kinnaras, स्वस्त्रीभिः with their own wives, क्रीडमानैः playing, च and, स्वर्गभूतम् appearing like heaven, महोच्छ्रयम् of great height.

40021183.author: Translation
40021183.content: The mountain, of immense height, appeared like heaven itself, with gods, demons, gandharvas, apsaras, and kinnaras playing there with their wives.

40021184.author: पदार्थः
40021184.content: नदीभिः by rivers, स्यन्दमानाभिः flowing, स्फटिकप्रतिमम् crystal-like, जलम् water, फणाभिः with hoods, चलजिह्वाभिः with flickering tongues, अनन्तम् Ananta, इव as if, विष्ठितम् pervaded.

40021184.author: Translation
40021184.content: The mountain was pervaded by crystal-clear water from flowing rivers, and appeared as if Ananta, the serpent god with his hoods and flickering tongues, had spread himself across it.

40021185.author: पदार्थः
40021185.content: उत्क्रामन्तम् rising high, दरीवन्तम् having caves, हिमवत्सन्निभम् resembling the Himalayas, गिरिम् mountain, पश्यमानः seeing, ततः then, विन्ध्यम् the Vindhya, रावणः Ravana, नर्मदाम् to the Narmada, ययौ went.

40021185.author: Translation
40021185.content: Ravana, after observing the Vindhya mountain, which rose high, possessed many caves, and resembled the Himalayas, then proceeded to the Narmada river.

40021186.author: पदार्थः
40021186.content: चलोपलजलाम् whose water moved over pebbles, पुण्याम् sacred, पश्चिमोदधिगामिनीम् flowing towards the western ocean.

40021186.author: Translation
40021186.content: Ravana went to the Narmada river, which was sacred, had water agitated by moving pebbles, and flowed towards the western ocean.

40021187.author: पदार्थः
40021187.content: महिषैः by buffaloes, सृमरैः by sṛmara deer, सिंहैः by lions, शार्दूलर्क्षगजोत्तमैः by tigers, bears, and excellent elephants, उष्णाभितप्तैः tormented by heat, तृषितैः thirsty, सङ्क्षोभितजलाशयाम् whose waters were agitated.

40021187.author: Translation
40021187.content: The Narmada's waters were agitated by buffaloes, sṛmara deer, lions, tigers, bears, and magnificent elephants, all of whom were tormented by the heat and seeking to quench their thirst.

40021188.author: पदार्थः
40021188.content: चक्रवाकैः by chakravaka birds, सकारण्डैः with karanda ducks, सहंसजलकुक्कुटैः with swans and water-hens, सारसैश्च and by sarasa cranes, सदा always, मत्तैः intoxicated (joyful), सुकूजद्भिः sweetly cooing, समावृताम् surrounded.

40021188.author: Translation
40021188.content: The river was surrounded by chakravaka birds, karanda ducks, swans, water-hens, and sarasa cranes, all always joyful and sweetly cooing.

40021189.author: पदार्थः
40021189.content: फुल्लद्रुमकृतोत्तंसां having blooming trees as her head-ornaments, चक्रवाकयुगस्तनीम् having a pair of chakravaka birds as her breasts, विस्तीर्णपुलिनश्रोणीं having wide sandbanks as her hips, हंसावलिसुमेखलाम् having rows of swans as her beautiful girdle.

40021189.author: Translation
40021189.content: The river was adorned with blooming trees like head-ornaments, pairs of chakravaka birds like breasts, wide sandbanks like hips, and rows of swans like a beautiful girdle.

40021190.author: पदार्थः
40021190.content: पुष्परेण्वनुलिप्ताङ्गीं having her body smeared with pollen, जलफेनामलांशुकाम् having pure foam of water as her garment, जलावगाहसंस्पर्शां whose touch was like bathing in water, फुल्लोत्पलशुभेक्षणाम् having blooming lotuses as her auspicious eyes, पुष्पकादवरुह्याशु quickly descending from the Pushpaka, नर्मदां to the Narmada, सरितां वराम् the best of rivers.

40021190.author: Translation
40021190.content: With her body smeared with pollen, pure water foam as her garment, a refreshing touch like a bath, and auspicious eyes like blooming lotuses, Ravana quickly descended from the Pushpaka to the Narmada, the best of rivers.

40021191.author: पदार्थः
40021191.content: इष्टामिव like a desired, वरां excellent, नारीम् woman, अवगाह्य having entered, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), स he, तस्याः her, पुलिने on the sandbank, रम्ये beautiful, नानामुनिनिषेविते frequented by various sages.

40021191.author: Translation
40021191.content: Ravana, having entered the Narmada as if embracing a beloved woman, then sat on her beautiful sandbank, which was frequented by various sages.

40021192.author: पदार्थः
40021192.content: उपोपविष्टैः seated nearby, सचिवैः with his ministers, सार्धं together with, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the foremost of rakshasas (Ravana), प्रख्याय having declared, नर्मदां the Narmada, सः he, अथ then, गङ्गेयमिति "this is Ganga", रावणः Ravana.

40021192.author: Translation
40021192.content: The foremost of rakshasas, Ravana, then sat with his ministers who were seated nearby, mistakenly declaring the Narmada to be the Ganga.

40021193.author: पदार्थः
40021193.content: नर्मदादर्शजम् from seeing the Narmada, हर्षम् joy, आप्तवान् obtained, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of rakshasas, उवाच said, सचिवान् to his ministers, तत्र there, सलीलम् playfully, शुकसारणौ to Shuka and Sarana,

40021193.author: Translation
40021193.content: The lord of rakshasas, having experienced joy from seeing the Narmada, playfully spoke to his ministers Shuka and Sarana there.

40021194.author: पदार्थः
40021194.content: एष this, रश्मिसहस्रेण with a thousand rays, जगत् the world, कृत्वैव having made indeed, काञ्चनम् golden, तीक्ष्णतापकरः causing intense heat, सूर्यः the sun, नभसः of the sky, अर्धम् half, समाश्रितः has occupied,

40021194.author: Translation
40021194.content: This sun, having made the world golden with its thousand rays and causing intense heat, has indeed reached the middle of the sky.

40021195.author: पदार्थः
40021195.content: माम् me, आसीनम् seated, विदित्वैव having known indeed, चन्द्रायति acts like the moon, दिवाकरः the sun,

40021195.author: Translation
40021195.content: The sun, knowing that I am seated here, indeed acts like the moon (becomes cool).

40021196.author: पदार्थः
40021196.content: नर्मदाजलशीतश्च and cool with Narmada's water, सुगन्धिः fragrant, श्रमनाशनः destroyer of fatigue, मद्भयात् from my fear, अनिलः the wind, अपि even, अत्र here, वाति blows, एष this, सुसमाहितः very carefully,

40021196.author: Translation
40021196.content: Even this wind, cool with the Narmada's water, fragrant, and a destroyer of fatigue, blows here very carefully out of fear of me.

40021197.author: पदार्थः
40021197.content: इयम् this, वा अपि or even, सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा best of rivers, नर्मदा Narmada, नर्मवर्धिनी increasing joy, नक्रमीनविहङ्गोर्मिः having crocodiles, fish, birds, and waves, सभयेव अङ्गना like a frightened woman, स्थिता stands,

40021197.author: Translation
40021197.content: This Narmada, the best of rivers and increaser of joy, with its crocodiles, fish, birds, and waves, stands as if a frightened woman.

40021198.author: पदार्थः
40021198.content: तत् therefore, भवन्तः you, क्षताः wounded, शस्त्रैः by weapons, नृपैः by kings, इन्द्रसमैः equal to Indra, युधि in battle, चन्दनस्य of sandalwood, रसेन with the juice, इव as if, रुधिरेण with blood, समुक्षिताः drenched.

40021198.author: Translation
40021198.content: Therefore, you, who were wounded in battle by kings equal to Indra, are drenched in blood as if with sandalwood paste.

40021199.author: पदार्थः
40021199.content: ते those, यूयम् you, अवगाहध्वम् plunge into, नर्मदां the Narmada, शर्मदां bestowing happiness, शुभाम् auspicious, महापद्ममुखाः led by Mahapadma, मत्ताः intoxicated, गङ्गाम् into the Ganga, इव like, गहागजाः wild elephants; अस्याम् in this, स्नात्वा having bathed, महानद्याम् in the great river, पाप्मानम् sin, विप्रमोक्ष्यथ you will be freed from.

40021199.author: Translation
40021199.content: You should plunge into the auspicious and joy-giving Narmada river, just as rutting wild elephants led by Mahapadma plunge into the Ganga, and by bathing in this great river, you will be freed from sin.

40021200.author: पदार्थः
40021200.content: अहम् I, अपि also, अद्य today, पुलिने on the sandbank, शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे having the luster of the autumn moon, पुष्पोपहारम् a flower offering, शनकैः gently, करिष्यामि will make, कपर्दिनः to Kapardin (Shiva).

40021200.author: Translation
40021200.content: I also will gently make a flower offering to Kapardin (Shiva) today on the sandbank, which shines like the autumn moon.

40021201.author: पदार्थः
40021201.content: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् thus, उक्ताः addressed, तु indeed, प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः Prahasta, Shuka, and Sarana, समहोदरधूम्राक्षाः along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, नर्मदां into the Narmada, विजगाहिरे plunged.

40021201.author: Translation
40021201.content: Thus addressed by Ravana, Prahasta, Shuka, Sarana, along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, plunged into the Narmada river.

40021202.author: पदार्थः
40021202.content: राक्षसेन्द्रगजैः by those chief Rakshasas (who are like elephants), तैः by them, तु indeed, क्षोभिता agitated, नर्मदा the Narmada, नदी river, वामनाञ्जनपद्माद्यैः by Vamana, Anjana, Padma, and others, गङ्गा the Ganga, इव like, महागजैः by great elephants.

40021202.author: Translation
40021202.content: The Narmada river was agitated by those chief Rakshasas, who were like great elephants, just as the Ganga is disturbed by great elephants like Vamana, Anjana, and Padma.

40021203.author: पदार्थः
40021203.content: ततः then, ते those, राक्षसाः Rākṣasas, स्नात्वा having bathed, नर्मदायाम् in the Narmada, महाबलाः mighty, उत्तीर्य having come out, पुष्पाणि flowers, आजह्रुः brought, बल्यर्थम् for the offering, रावणस्य of Ravana, तु indeed.

40021203.author: Translation
40021203.content: Then, those mighty Rākṣasas, having bathed in the Narmada and emerged from the water, brought flowers for Ravana's offering.

40021204.author: पदार्थः
40021204.content: नर्मदापुलिने on the sandbank of the Narmada, हृद्ये charming, शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे having a luster like a white cloud, राक्षसैः by the Rākṣasas, तु indeed, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, कृतः was made, पुष्पमयः made of flowers, गिरिः a mountain.

40021204.author: Translation
40021204.content: On the charming sandbank of the Narmada, which shone like a white cloud, the Rākṣasas swiftly created a mountain of flowers in a moment.

40021205.author: पदार्थः
40021205.content: पुष्पेषु when the flowers, उपहृतेषु were brought, एवम् thus, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of Rākṣasas, अवतीर्णः descended, नदीम् into the river, स्नातुम् to bathe, गङ्गाम् into the Ganga, इव like, महागजः a great elephant.

40021205.author: Translation
40021205.content: When the flowers were thus brought, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, descended into the river to bathe, just like a great elephant entering the Ganga.

40021206.author: पदार्थः
40021206.content: तत्र there, स्नात्वा having bathed, च and, विधिवत् according to ritual, जप्त्वा having recited, जप्यम् the mantra, अनुत्तमम् excellent, नर्मदासलिलात् from the waters of the Narmada, तस्मात् from that, उत्ततार he emerged, सः that, रावणः Ravana.

40021206.author: Translation
40021206.content: Having bathed there according to ritual and recited the excellent mantra, that Ravana then emerged from the waters of the Narmada.

40021207.author: पदार्थः
40021207.content: ततः then, क्लिन्नाम्बरम् wet garment, त्यक्त्वा having discarded, शुक्लवस्त्रसमावृतम् covered with white garments, रावणम् Ravana, प्राञ्जलिम् with folded hands, यान्तम् going, अन्वयुः followed, सर्वराक्षसाः all the Rākṣasas.

40021207.author: Translation
40021207.content: Then, having discarded his wet garment and now clad in white, Ravana proceeded with folded hands, followed by all the Rākṣasas.

40021208.author: पदार्थः
40021208.content: तद्गतीवशमापन्ना having come under the sway of his movement, मूर्तिमन्तः embodied, इव as if, अचलाः mountains, यत्र यत्र wherever, च and, याति स्म went, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of Rakshasas, जाम्बूनदमयम् made of pure gold, लिङ्गम् the Lingam, तत्र तत्र there, स्म नीयते was carried.

40021208.author: Translation
40021208.content: Wherever Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, went, the golden Shiva Lingam, as if an embodied mountain that had come under the sway of his movement, was carried along with him.

40021209.author: पदार्थः
40021209.content: वालुकावेदिमध्ये in the middle of a sand altar, तु indeed, तल्लिङ्गम् that Lingam, स्थाप्य having placed, रावणः Ravana, अर्चयामास worshipped, गन्धैः with fragrances, च and, पुष्पैः with flowers, च and, अमृतगन्धिभिः having the fragrance of nectar.

40021209.author: Translation
40021209.content: Ravana placed that Lingam in the middle of a sand altar and worshipped it with fragrant substances and flowers that smelled like nectar.

40021210.author: पदार्थः
40021210.content: ततः then, सताम् of the good, आर्तिहरम् the remover of distress, परम् the supreme, वरम् boon (or best one), वरप्रदम् the giver of boons, चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम् adorned with moonbeams, समर्चयित्वा having worshipped well, सः he, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Ravana), जगौ sang, प्रसार्य having stretched out, हस्तान् his hands, प्रणनर्त danced, च and, अग्रतः in front.

40021210.author: Translation
40021210.content: Then, having worshipped Shiva, who removes the distress of the virtuous, is the supreme boon, grants boons, and is adorned with the moon's rays, Ravana, the night-wanderer, sang and danced in front of the deity with outstretched hands. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 31 ।। Thus ends the thirty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
